tasks.description: Design and implement a notification system that can handle various types of events. The system should be able to send notifications to users in a timely manner. The system should also be able to handle different notification channels such as email, in-app notifications, and push notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has enabled notifications, when an important event occurs, then the user receives a notification within 5 minutes.

tasks.description: Identify important events that should trigger notifications and implement event triggers. Event triggers should be able to detect when an important event occurs and send a notification to the user.
acceptance_criteria: Given an important event occurs, when the event trigger is enabled, then the notification system is notified.

tasks.description: Design and implement notification templates for different types of events. Notification templates should be customizable and able to handle different notification channels.
acceptance_criteria: Given a notification template is created, when a notification is sent, then the notification is formatted correctly.

tasks.description: Implement a frequency control mechanism to prevent spamming users with too many notifications. The mechanism should be able to detect when a user is receiving too many notifications and limit the number of notifications sent.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is receiving notifications, when the frequency control mechanism is enabled, then the number of notifications sent is limited to a reasonable amount.

tasks.description: Implement user notification preferences to allow users to customize their notification settings. Users should be able to choose which types of notifications they receive and how they receive them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user has customized their notification preferences, when a notification is sent, then the notification is sent according to the user's preferences.

tasks.description: Write tests to ensure the notification system is working correctly. Tests should cover different scenarios and edge cases.
acceptance_criteria: Given a notification test is run, when the test is completed, then the test results indicate the notification system is working correctly.

tasks.summary: Migrate existing events to new system
tasks.description: Migrate existing events to the new notification system. This should include updating event triggers and notification templates to work with the new system.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing event is migrated, when the event occurs, then the new notification system sends a notification correctly.
